name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
description: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits — fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.

videos.title: Origins: Star-Lord: Part 1
videos.overview: See what happens right after little Peter Quill is beamed aboard that Ravager spaceship and meets Yondu and his alien pirates.

videos.title: Origins: Star-Lord: Part 2
videos.overview: Yondu's crew wants to eat young Peter Quill because they have never sampled a Terran before.

videos.title: Origins: Groot: Part 1
videos.overview: The inspirational tale of young Groot becoming the last surviving member of his race.

videos.title: Origins: Groot: Part 2
videos.overview: The inspirational tale of young Groot becoming the last surviving member of his race.

videos.title: Origins: Rocket Raccoon: Part 1
videos.overview: How one simple creature transforms into the brilliant, tech-savvy, trouble-maker named Rocket - and how he befriends a captive tree-creature.

videos.title: Origins: Rocket Raccoon: Part 2
videos.overview: How one simple creature transforms into the brilliant, tech-savvy, trouble-maker named Rocket - and how he befriends a captive tree-creature.

videos.title: Origins: Drax: Part 1
videos.overview: A galactic fighting superstar deals with his past, as he finds he must choose between revenge and doing the right thing.

videos.title: Origins: Drax: Part 2
videos.overview: A galactic fighting superstar deals with his past, as he finds he must choose between revenge and doing the right thing.

videos.title: Origins: Gamora: Part 1
videos.overview: Gamora's loyalty to Thanos and Ronan is tested when she is given her first opportunity to choose a better path.

videos.title: Origins: Gamora: Part 2
videos.overview: Gamora's loyalty to Thanos and Ronan is tested when she is given her first opportunity to choose a better path.

videos.title: Pick up the Pieces
videos.overview: The Guardians accidentally crash their ship.

videos.title: Star-Lord vs. Modok!
videos.overview: Quill tries to retrieve a fusion reactor from Modok.

videos.title: Drax Attacks!
videos.overview: Rocket sends Drax to a local carnival to retrieve a giant stuffed animal.

videos.title: Rocket! Groot! Man-Thing!
videos.overview: While trying to fix the ship, a mysterious Man-Thing starts wreaking havoc and Rocket and Groot must defend the Milano.

videos.title: Gamora Strikes!
videos.overview: Gramora goes to a laser tag arcade to retrieve a specialized laser but decides to help a young boy being bullied.

videos.title: Guardians Reunited!
videos.overview: The Guardians reunite to defend against the mysterious Man-Thing while Rocket tries to fix the ship.

videos.title: Road to Knowhere
videos.overview: The newly-christened Guardians of the Galaxy come into possession of a dangerous artifact that has Thanos’ new lieutenant, Korath, after them.

videos.title: Knowhere to Run
videos.overview: The Guardians struggle to subdue the suddenly-sprung-to-life Celestial head that is the Knowhere space colony, as well as storm Korath’s ship to rescue Quill, Gamora and the mysterious CryptoCube that holds the Cosmic Seed.

videos.title: One in a Million You
videos.overview: Feeling underappreciated, Rocket accepts an offer to work for The Collector, only to realize his “job” is working as another prisoner in The Collector’s collection.

videos.title: Take the Milano and Run
videos.overview: The Guardians crash land on a space station run by the Grandmaster, who schemes to get Drax back in the gladiatorial arena to battle his ultimate opponent: Gamora.

videos.title: Can't Fight This Seedling
videos.overview: When Groot is infected by a parasitic fungus, the Guardians must embark on a perilous journey in order to save him.

videos.title: Undercover Angle
videos.overview: Caught red-handed by Titus, the Guardians are coerced into infiltrating a notorious gang of weapons dealers known as the Black Order.

videos.title: The Backstabbers
videos.overview: Quill gets mixed up in a game of deceit when Gamora tries to pit her siblings, Nebula and Korath, against each other.

videos.title: Hitchin' a Ride
videos.overview: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits â€” fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.

videos.title: We Are Family
videos.overview: Rocket is abducted and taken back to his home planet, Half World.

videos.title: Bad Moon Rising
videos.overview: The Guardians encounter a living planet that's fallen under the control of a revived Ronan.

videos.title: Space Cowboys
videos.overview: The Guardians get caught up in a rivalry between The Collector and The Grandmaster.

videos.title: Crystal Blue Persuasion
videos.overview: The Guardians must help save the City of Attilan from Ronan.

videos.title: Stuck in the Metal with You
videos.overview: The Guardians find the Asgardian Destroyer Armor that leads to an epic battle pitting the Detroyer Armor against Drax the Destroyer.

videos.title: Don't Stop Believin'
videos.overview: Quill goes missing while following the Cryptocube's readings.

videos.title: Accidents Will Happen
videos.overview: The Guardians must stop Ronan's plan to blow up the Kree Supreme Intelligence.

videos.title: We Are the World Tree
videos.overview: In search of the Cosmic Seed, the Guardians unexpectedly find themselves in Asgard where they must outwit Thor and Angela in order to discover the seed's origins.

videos.title: Come and Gut Your Love
videos.overview: Following a falling out with his father, Star-Lord finds a ship containing the A.I. Rora as he takes it off of Spartax with the Drax the Destroyer and Groot providing a diversion for the Spartax Royal Guards. Afterwards, the Guardians of the Galaxy have to deal with Lucy and Supergiant who are jilted that Star-Lord is the Prince of Sparta.

videos.title: Asgard War (1): Lightnin' Strikes
videos.overview: When Asgard attacks Spartax, Quill and the Guardians become caught in the middle trying to expose the deception behind the conflict.

videos.title: Asgard War (2): Rescue Me
videos.overview: The Guardians and Asgardians team up to rescue Quill from Thanos.

videos.title: Fox on the Run
videos.overview: Gamora attempts to make amends for her past misdeeds only to find herself in a deadly trap set by Nebula, Ronan and the Grandmaster.

videos.title: Inhuman Touch
videos.overview: The Guardians pay the Inhumans a visit to learn more about the Cosmic Seed.

videos.title: Welcome Back
videos.overview: The Guardians discover that the Cosmic Seed is back on Earth. In the company of Cosmo, Star-Lord returns to his hometown where he runs into his childhood bully Michael Coogan who is now the sheriff. Now Star-Lord and the Guardians of the Galaxy must find the Cosmic Seed before Korath the Pursuer does.

videos.title: I've Been Searching So Long
videos.overview: When the Guardians of the Galaxy's search for the Cosmic Seed continues on Earth, Star-Lord contacts Gorgon where he gets the location of the former site of Attilan. While checking out the area, Rocket Raccoon, Groot, and Drax the Destroyer have visions of the Cosmic Seed energy helping them out like Rocket Raccoon's family being re-evolved, Groot being able to restore the Flora colossi, and Drax the Destroyer being able to see his family again. Even after fighting their way past the Cosmic Seed-enhanced worms and spiders, the Guardians of the Galaxy must keep Ronan the Accuser and Nebula from getting the box containing the Cosmic Seed.

videos.title: I Feel the Earth Move
videos.overview: Now that Thanos has the Cosmic Seed, he takes control of the Earth and molds it into his personal planetary weapon of mass destruction. The Guardians of the Galaxy must work to reclaim the Cosmic Seed from Thanos even when Ronan the Accuser and Nebula plan to dispose of Thanos with plans of having the Earth be destroyed alongside him.

videos.title: Won't Get Fooled Again
videos.overview: The Guardians discover that Yondu has been impersonating them in order to con unsuspecting victims.

videos.title: Jingle Bell Rock
videos.overview: The team stages a Christmas Carol inspired con-job in order to frighten a despot out of his ill-gotten riches and free his enslaved people.

videos.title: Stayin' Alive
videos.overview: While trying to dispose of Thanos' asteroid, the Guardians discover it has been taken to a secure facility that belongs to the Avengers.

videos.title: Evolution Rock
videos.overview: The Guardians and the Avengers team up to find out what powerful secrets lie inside Thanos' asteroid.

videos.title: Lyin' Eyes
videos.overview: When Rocket and Drax wake up with absolutely no memory of the night before, the Guardians must piece together their adventures.

videos.title: Free Bird
videos.overview: While the Guardians search for the missing sarcophagus, Groot finds a mysterious egg and does everything in his power to protect it.

videos.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
videos.overview: When the Guardians are charged with escorting the young and rebellious Rigellian Princess Tana back home, Drax's hardened heart melts as he is reminded of his own daughter.

videos.title: Black Helmet Woman
videos.overview: After being infused with incredible power from a Nova Helmet, Gamora leads the Guardians and her sister Nebula on a mission to infiltrate the Believer flagship.

videos.title: Right Place, Wrong Time
videos.overview: Quill and Gamora battle the High Evolutionary, his minion hybrids and a teleport-hijacking Nebula.

videos.title: Me and You and a Dog Named Cosmo
videos.overview: Cosmo goes undercover on the Believer Flagship but loses his powers when his cover is blown.

videos.title: Can't Get It Out Of My Head
videos.overview: When the Believer Flagship embeds itself in Knowhere's brain, it causes a planetoid-wide telekinetic zombie outbreak.

videos.title: Rock Your Baby
videos.overview: When the cocoon opens and reveals a baby warlock inside, the Guardians have to step in to be a positive guiding force to keep his powers in check.

videos.title: Symbiote War (1): Wild World
videos.overview: The Guardians discover Groot's homeworld, Planet X, has been overrun by Symbiotes who will stop at nothing to get Groot's restarted World Pod for themselves to conquer the galaxy.

videos.title: Symbiote War (2): I Will Survive
videos.overview: As a comet covered in Symbiotes hurls toward Spartax, the Guardians must team up with Quill's sister to save the planet.

videos.title: Symbiote War (3): Thunder Road
videos.overview: When the Symbiotes escape to Asgard and venomize Thor, Odin and the other Asgardians, it is up to the Guardians to save them, the World Tree and all of existence.

videos.title: Back in Black
videos.overview: The Guardians meet Sam Alexander, an Earth teen experimenting with his father’s Nova helmet, but the Guardians aren’t the only ones who know of the helmet’s power.

videos.title: Knights in Black Helmets
videos.overview: The Guardians chase after J’son and Mantis as they try to manipulate Sam to do their bidding by promising him clues to the location of his missing father.

videos.title: Nova Me, Nova You
videos.overview: When the Nova Corps catch up with the Guardians and Sam, the fight reaches Sam’s hometown.

videos.title: Mr. Roboto
videos.overview: Searching for a weapon strong enough to match J’son, the Guardians seek out master boom-maker Ja Kyee.

videos.title: Destroyer
videos.overview: When the guardians travel to Drax's home planet in hopes of summoning Warlock, they discover Xeron seeks to destroy Adam and Drax's homecoming, which becomes a fight to protect his friends.

videos.title: You Can't Always Get What You Want
videos.overview: Rocket and Warlock travel to Halfworld to try and re-evolve Rocket's family.

videos.title: I've Seen All Good People
videos.overview: Gamora trains Warlock to be a strong and powerful warrior like herself. But when Gamora’s lessons become too intense, Warlock clams up and gets kidnapped by the Collector.

videos.title: Another One Bites the Dust
videos.overview: When Quill and Warlock are hunted by J'son and the Black Order, Quill teaches Warlock the importance of never letting himself slip into the path of evil.

videos.title: It's Tricky
videos.overview: During the Xandrian Feast of the Three Grinning Moons, the Guardians must pull a reverse heist by planting a dangerous weapon inside a Nova Corps vault.

videos.title: You're No Good
videos.overview: Warlock has gone dark! By absorbing J’son into his gem, Warlock has become Dark Warlock (Magus) with his sights set on conquering the galaxy, starting with Spartax.

videos.title: Behind Gold Eyes
videos.overview: The Guardians and Nova battle Dark Warlock (Magus) and J’son on Planet Y. Can our heroes save their friend Warlock and the universe before it’s too late?

videos.title: Unfortunate Son
videos.overview: In order to save the Guardians from the ruthless asteroid Korvac, Quill must bust J'Son out of prison on Spartax and in the process he sees a new side of his father.

videos.title: Mission: Breakout
videos.overview: The Guardians must work together to escape the elaborate prisons created for them by The Collector.

videos.title: Back in the New York Groove
videos.overview: The Guardians meet up with Spider-Man in New York City to defeat Thanos’ super-powered symbiote.

videos.title: Drive My Carnage
videos.overview: The Guardians team up with Spider-Man to battle Thanos, who has harnessed the power of the Carnage Symbiote to become the ultimate weapon.

videos.title: I Fought the Law
videos.overview: The Guardians have captured Thanos, but it's no easy task transporting the most wanted criminal in the galaxy.

videos.title: Titan Up
videos.overview: The Guardians chase Thanos and Sam Alexander (Nova) to Thanos’ home planet of Titan, where they discover a gladiatorial arena featuring Jesse Alexander - Nova’s father!

videos.title: Money Changes Everything
videos.overview: The Guardians now have everything they ever dreamed of, but money can’t solve their problems.

videos.title: Sisters Are Doin' It for Themselves
videos.overview: Gamora decides to use her new riches to repay all of the people she has wronged throughout the years. When Nebula shows up, Gamora tries to teach her the value of doing good.

videos.title: We Are the Champions
videos.overview: Drax decides he no longer wants to be a Destroyer and looks into new occupations.

videos.title: Fame
videos.overview: Quill starts his own talk show after beating Thanos! But to his dismay, everyone seems to hate it, especially the Grandmaster who is rigging the segments to destroy Quill.

videos.title: Happy Together
videos.overview: The Guardians squander their riches and take on a simple transport job. It turns out that they are stealing from the Kree, and Phyla the Accuser will do anything to get it back!

videos.title: Gotta Get Outta this Place
videos.overview: The Guardians find themselves in prison for stealing a mysterious package from the Kree - but it was all a set up by Howard the Duck.

videos.title: Long Distance Runaround
videos.overview: The Guardians track down Howard the Duck to find out who set them up and why, but they don’t get far before Phyla the Accuser catches up to them to deliver some Kree justice.

videos.title: You Don't Own Me
videos.overview: Phyla-Vell reluctantly teams up with the Guardians to bring The Collector to justice for destroying her home planet.

videos.title: Black Vortex (1)
videos.overview: When the Guardians become separated in the Black Vortex, Gamora wakes up in a children’s fairy tale, while Drax is trapped in a comic book.

videos.title: Black Vortex (2)
videos.overview: While caught in a CG sinister packing factory, Rocket must search for his best friend Groot and escape.

videos.title: Black Vortex (3)
videos.overview: Quill finds himself in a claymation world where the Milano is flying into the sun, threatening to melt him. Meanwhile, Groot and Drax must fight Ronan in a Golden Age world.

videos.title: Black Vortex (4)
videos.overview: Gamora and Quill battle their way through an 8-bit Super Marvel World.

videos.title: Blame It on the Boss of Nova
videos.overview: The Guardians finally make it out of the Black Vortex, only to find that the galaxy has been taken over by sinister robots called the Darkhawks, who are disguised as their friends.

videos.title: The Real Me
videos.overview: The Guardians don’t know who to trust as the Darkhawks seem to have duplicated everyone, including Quill.

videos.title: Paranoid
videos.overview: The Guardians finally make it out of the Black Vortex, only to find that the galaxy has been taken over by sinister robots called the Darkhawks, who are disguised as their friends.

videos.title: Darkhawks on the Edge of Town
videos.overview: The Guardians don't know who to trust as the Darkhawks seem to have duplicated everyone, including Quill.

videos.title: Holding Out for a Hero
videos.overview: The Guardians have to team up with Loki in Asgard when The Serpent infects the World Tree and threatens to destroy the universe.

videos.title: With a Little Help From My Friends
videos.overview: As the Guardians prepare to take the fight to The Serpent, they Bifrost around the galaxy to gather reinforcements.

videos.title: Breaking Stuff is Hard to Do
videos.overview: The Guardians and their friends search for the fragments of Dragonfang, a legendary weapon that will finally be able to defeat The Serpent forever.

videos.title: Killer Queen
videos.overview: The Guardians, Loki and Iron Man travel to the castle of the evil Hela to ask her help in fighting The Serpent.

videos.title: Just One Victory
videos.overview: With the Nova Corps defeated and the fate of the entire universe in jeopardy, the Guardians must turn to an unlikely ally to stop The Serpent.
